title: Verifier-execute join: verifier tasks done by a non-creator need no handoff
subject: verifier-execute-exception
ratio: The sanctioned exception to producer-never-approves: a task whose role is verifier, where the task itself is the review or execution step (tournament verdicts, epic joins), may go straight to done with no handoff, provided the acting agent differs from the task's created_by. Self-done by the creator is still refused. Worker-role and thinker-role tasks are unchanged. The exception covers artifact-free verdict tasks only; it never covers artifact-producing work.
dicta: Tier 2 on P-022 (audit_gen4 rank 2); applied at T-056, verdicted done by verifier-b (events.jsonl ts 2026-07-05T06:51:01Z); every use logs event verifier_execute_done. The exception must name its rule: this record cites the producer-never-approves record published earlier in this wave. This epic verify tasks run on exactly this path. Frozen by the codification ledger row decision:T-377#cd-11.
scope_conditions: role:verifier executing an owns-nothing join task created by a different agent
revisit_trigger: Revisit if the exception is shown covering artifact-producing tasks, or the creator-self-done refusal weakens.
validity_conditions: a verifier-role task done by a non-creator exits 0 without handoff; self-done still refused
